Helpful answers

South Alabama real estate questions

Where does Montgomery & Co. help buyers and sellers?

Montgomery & Co. serves South Alabama, including Fairhope, Daphne, Spanish Fort, Loxley, Foley, Gulf Shores, and Orange Beach. Contact Haley Montgomery to discuss your preferred area and next move.

Who is the broker at Montgomery & Co.?

Haley Montgomery is the broker and owner of Montgomery & Co. She has 11 years of real estate industry experience and works with buyers, sellers, investors, first-time buyers, veterans, and retirees.

How can I find homes for sale in Baldwin County?

Use the Find a Home page to open the Baldwin REALTORS® property search. Contact Haley to confirm availability, discuss your priorities, and arrange a showing. Live MLS listings are not yet connected to this website.

Can Haley help first-time buyers, veterans, and retirees?

Yes. Haley works with first-time buyers, veterans, and retirees, as well as sellers and investors. She can help you explore homes, understand the buying or selling process, and plan your next steps.

How do I contact Haley Montgomery?

Call or text (251) 308-0016 or email haleymontgomery.realty@gmail.com to talk about buying, selling, or investing in South Alabama.
